name: KevlinX BRU01 Brussels
notes: Operator says BRU01 is in the northern Brussels City Region, 32MW+ overall, with 16MW IT capacity in phase one; KevlinX announced it was live at the start of 2026.

name: Digital Realty BRU3 Brussels
notes: Digital Realty lists BRU3 as a Brussels data center on its Brussels campus; original Interxion announcement covered construction of a third Brussels data centre.

name: Microsoft Azure Belgium Central cloud region
notes: Microsoft officially opened Azure Belgium Central on 2025-11-18. Facility locations are not disclosed; reporting places the multi-zone region around Brussels, so this is assigned to the Brussels division at region level.

name: LCL Brussels-North Diegem expansion/new facility
notes: LCL launched its newest and largest data center at Brussels-North in Diegem, east of Brussels, after expansion work that broke ground in April 2024.

name: LCL Brussels-West Aalst
notes: Aalst/Erembodegem facility operating as LCL Brussels-West; trade coverage notes Tier III certification and an investment program.

name: LCL Antwerp
notes: LCL lists Antwerp among its Belgian Tier 3 data center facilities; facility address is Noorderlaan 133, Antwerp.

name: KBC Mechelen data center
notes: KBC applied for environmental permits for new replacement data centers; BDIA later reported building permits secured. The Mechelen site is at KBC Campus Mechelen.

name: KBC Heist-op-den-Berg data center
notes: Second KBC replacement data center planned for the Liersesteenweg industrial park in Heist-op-den-Berg; permit coverage indicates approval.

name: Datacenter United Kortrijk data center
notes: Datacenter United said construction of a new data center had started on the southern axis of Kortrijk; later trade coverage repeated that work had begun.

name: Datacenter United Antwerp DC
notes: Datacenter United lists Antwerp among its Belgian data center locations; Uptime client story references the Antwerp Datacenter Tier IV design certification project.

name: Digital Realty BRU4 Zaventem
notes: Digital Realty lists BRU4 as the newest addition to its Brussels campus; project reporting placed the new data centre in Zaventem, Flemish Brabant.

name: EdgeConneX Brussels campus, Ternat
notes: Operator page places the Belgian market campus in Ternat, under 18 km from downtown Brussels.

name: Google St. Ghislain-Mons data center campus
notes: Google's St. Ghislain-Mons campus in Hainaut is operational and is being expanded as part of a EUR5bn Belgium AI/data center investment through 2027.

name: Google Farciennes data center campus
notes: Google began construction in April 2024 on a new data center in Farciennes, Hainaut; later official Google material refers to ongoing Wallonia data center expansion.

name: Google Feluy-Ecaussinnes data center project
notes: Trade reports say Google's Wallonia project in the Feluy-Ecaussinnes industrial zone has obtained a permit but faces high-voltage grid connection constraints.

name: LCL Wallonia One Gembloux
notes: LCL acquired the former ENGIE Solutions data center in Gembloux and renamed it LCL Wallonia One; later coverage confirms ongoing operation and solar-park expansion.

name: Wallonie Data Center
notes: WDC operator site identifies an active Wallonia data center and reports Tier III certification in French-speaking Belgium.
